text:
alex.mktg: urgent ask for launch post + webinar slide — we need a 200-sample validation run (gen-only) of our social cohort. deliverables: quantized vs fp16 p50/p95/p99, avg tokens, plus per-length-bucket percentiles (0-128,129-512,513-1024). also need 5 redacted example outputs for legal. ETA EOD.

rachel.runtime: got it. which manifest/cohort and do you want cold-starts included? any specific batching mode to test?

alex.mktg: cohort = "social_launch_bucketed_v1" (200 samples, mix across lengths). include cold + warmed KV. batching = production (continuous batching). priority HIGH — legal review before PR.

sam.dataops: manifest uploaded: s3://rdw-marketing/samples/social_launch_bucketed_v1/manifest_2026-05-11.json
note: 5 items are flagged as "long" (>880) to exercise truncation path; marked "long": true in manifest.

tom.eng: recommended run flags for reproducibility:
```
--model redwood-v2-3b
--precision fp16,quantized
--batching continuous
--warmup_requests 25
--max_seq 1024
--seed 555
--collect_traces true
--redact true
--bucket_percentiles true
```
will capture token breakdown and buckets.

rachel.runtime: queuing on staging-dedicated with those flags. ETA ~25m. I'll post run id when queued.

benchbot: queued run r-2026-05-11-022 on staging-dedicated-9

alex.mktg: can we also get a tiny replay bundle suitable for an interactive webinar demo? small enough to share with product marketing.

rachel.runtime: yes — we'll produce a replay.tar.gz with the sanitized requests and trace ids; note it won't include KVs. ETA with artifacts.

benchbot: run r-2026-05-11-022 started. estimated 22m.

rachel.runtime: quick heads-up — quantized can increase p99 on long traces when batching pools are full; we'll include per-bucket p99 so you can see the tail.

benchbot: run r-2026-05-11-022 completed. artifacts uploaded:
- s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-2026-05-11-022/summary_bucketed.csv
- s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-2026-05-11-022/samples_redacted.jsonl
- s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-2026-05-11-022/replay.tar.gz
- s3://rdw-marketing/benchmarks/r-2026-05-11-022/traces/

tom.eng: pulled numbers from summary_bucketed.csv for slide and a short note. bucketed percentiles included.
quantized: p50 91ms, p95 432ms, p99 710ms, avg_tokens 267
  bucket 0-128: p95 180ms, p99 320ms
  bucket 129-512: p95 390ms, p99 620ms
  bucket 513-1024: p95 820ms, p99 1400ms (note: this bucket includes truncated items)

fp16: p50 79ms, p95 385ms, p99 660ms, avg_tokens 270
  bucket 0-128: p95 160ms, p99 290ms
  bucket 129-512: p95 350ms, p99 580ms
  bucket 513-1024: p95 750ms, p99 1280ms (truncation flagged)

sam.dataops: warning — 5 samples truncated at 1024 and flagged "truncated": true in samples_redacted.jsonl. those contribute heavily to p99 in the longest bucket.

alex.mktg: great — can you paste 5 redacted outputs here (or point to file)? legal needs to confirm no PII.

rachel.runtime: samples_redacted.jsonl contains the 5 representative outputs under the run artifact. quick snippet (redacted):
{"id":"s-001","output":"Hey there! [REDACTED]...","tokens":45}
{"id":"s-078","output":"Thanks for the update. [REDACTED]...","tokens":62}
{"id":"s-102","output":"Here are some tips: [REDACTED]...","tokens":87}
{"id":"s-177","output":"Sure thing — check this out: [REDACTED]...","tokens":51}
{"id":"s-199","output":"Final answer: [REDACTED]...","tokens":39}

legal.bot: received samples_redacted.jsonl and running automated PII checks. please confirm redact pipeline used the latest regexes.

tom.eng: confirmed redact pipeline v2.3 ran postprocess; it filters emails, phone numbers, credit-card-like strings. trace ids are included separately for ops debugging.

alex.mktg: draft slide copy: "p95 under 435ms on production-like social traffic (quantized); tail behavior shown per length bucket." will include link to artifacts and note about 5 truncated edge cases. tagging @legal for final signoff.

rachel.runtime: reproducibility command for README and PR:
./run_bench --manifest manifest_2026-05-11.json --run-id r-2026-05-11-022 --download-artifacts --bucket-percentiles

alex.mktg: can you also drop a one-line README into the webinar/assets/bench-snapshot folder with artifact paths and the reproduce command? I'll open the PR after legal.ok

tom.eng: will add README with the command and a short note about truncation and buckets.

legal.bot: quick scan complete — redacted examples pass automated checks. will sign wording shortly.

alex.mktg: awesome, amazing work — will wait for signoff then merge artifacts into the webinar repo. :rocket:
